resolved_findings.independent_verification: I inspected review-s351.jpg (scan 351, IA leaf n350) directly. The page is the 'שיר של יום' daily-psalm appendix. It holds Psalm 24, then the start of Psalm 48, with the day rubrics 'היום ראשון / היום שני בשבת שהו הלויים אומרים במקדש'. No printed page number appears anywhere on the leaf: not in the top margin around the heading, not in the bottom margin, and not in either outer margin. The marginal 'כד' and 'מח' mark psalm chapters 24 and 48, not pages. The small marks at the left of each rubric line are rubric/day labels, not folio numbers. appendix-page-evidence.json agrees: printed_page:null, printed_label:null, english_counterpart:false.
resolved_findings.disposition: Resolved; no longer blocking. The required_action in C-B1 assumed a printed page existed to record. None does, so leaving out pb/@n and biblScope unit='pages' faithfully reflects the source and fabricates nothing. Supplying '351' (a scan ordinal) or '24' / 'chapter24' (a psalm number) as a printed label would be wrong. The pb's unique facs …/page/n350.jpg (ed='1965') gives exact, unambiguous provenance for the leaf. No English counterpart is printed, so there is no parallel file to recheck.
